messages:
Anita: quick design review — rights panel hover tooltips, invite wizard microcopy, SSO CTA placement, and audit-log nav. Figma + screenshots: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Rights-Panel?node-id=0%3A1. Please drop accessibility & copy nits by EOD. :wave: Jordi: looked through — tooltips are 👍 but worried about hover-only behavior. Hover on table rows currently hides action buttons. Can we do an explicit info icon that opens a small popover on click? That handles keyboard users too. Maya: +1 to click-to-open. Also tooltip BG is too light — current gray-on-white fails WCAG AA for body text. Need at least 4.5:1 contrast or increase font weight. Also keyboard focus outline missing when popover opens via keyboard. Sam: invite wizard thoughts: the primary CTA reads "Send invites" but we often need to set roles during invite. UX options: (a) keep "Send invites" and open a secondary modal to assign roles after send, (b) add inline role selector before send. Prefer (b) for small batches, (a) for bulk. Also add a spinner/toast for bulk invites, folks get anxious. Zoe: SSO toggle copy: current label "Enforce SSO" sounds heavy-handed. Suggest "Require SSO for all sign-ins" or even "Require SSO for organization" — want wording that makes implications clear. Add an info tooltip that explains: "Users without SSO access will not be able to sign in; existing non-SSO sessions will be revoked" (confirm infra behavior). Anita: good. For audit-log nav: left rail feels dense. Could we move time range filters into the top bar and show quick presets (last 24h/7d/30d)? Also deep-linking to a specific user/event should be supported. Thoughts on keeping filters sticky while scrolling? Jordi: sticky top bar + horizontal filter chips sounds cleaner. If we remove tall left filter, mobile layout becomes simpler. Also make sure filter state is encoded in URL (so support shareable links). Maya: a11y test checklist I propose: keyboard-only flow for invite modal (tab order, focus trap), screen-reader announcements on bulk-send success/error (aria-live polite/assertive), contrast checks, NVDA/VoiceOver walkthrough for popovers, and test with high-zoom and RTL. I'll add to the test plan. Sam: copy nits: role names — "Viewer" is ambiguous. Users ask "viewer of what?" Maybe use "Read-only" or "Reporter" depending on domain. If we change names, coordinate with billing & support docs. Also microcopy inside invite modal: change "Invite by email" placeholder to "Enter email addresses, separated by comma" (helps people paste lists). Zoe: mobile note: the overflow menu for roles currently truncates tooltip content. For long role descriptions we should allow linewrap or expand modal. Also ensure touch target >=44px for the info icon. Anita: sounds actionable. I'll update the Figma with: click-to-open info icon, darker tooltip contrast, top-bar filters for audit log, and invite modal microcopy changes. Will also add a variant for small-batch vs bulk invites. Target: push updated frames by tomorrow morning. Jordi: tiny implementation detail: for the popover use role=\"dialog\" and set aria-modal=\"false\" for non-blocking, add aria-describedby to point to content ID. Example: ```
i
...text...
``` Maya: also ensure live region for bulk results: `
3/120 invited
` so screen-readers get progress updates. Sam: can we add a tiny inline copy for the SSO toggle: "Requiring SSO will prevent password sign-in" — short and explicit. Legal can review stronger warnings if needed. Zoe: +1. Also request analytics event names: `rights.tooltip_open`, `invite.bulk_submit`, `sso.require_toggle` so we can track adoption/errors. Anita: thanks — I'll add analytics props. If nobody objects I'll iterate and post updated frames. @ui-bot please create follow-up issue for implementation + a11y tests. :eyes: ui-bot: Created issue PLAT-4557: "Rights panel: switch tooltip to click, SSO CTA copy tweak, invite wizard progress + a11y checklist" — https://jira.internal/redwood/PLAT-4557. Assigned to @Sam. Sam: thanks — I'll pick this up after today's sprint groom. :thumbsup: Maya: leaving a11y checklist comments on figma now. Anita: great — will iterate and ping again.
